paper_id: Diff-MTS_ Temporal-Augmented Conditional Diffusion-based AIGC for Industrial Time Series Towards the Large Model Era
title: Diff-MTS: Temporal-Augmented Conditional Diffusion-based AIGC for Industrial Time Series Towards the Large Model Era
motivation: 工业时序数据因采集困难和隐私顾虑严重不足,阻碍智能维护和大模型构建
problem_framing: GAN生成工业多变量时序存在训练不稳定、条件一致性差、时序依赖复杂三大挑战
key_insight: 用扩散模型替代GAN,并通过自适应MMD损失和时序分解重建模块分别解决条件一致性和时序依赖问题
method_signature: 条件自适应Ada-MMD扩散模型+TDR-UNet时序分解重建U网络
evaluation_criteria: 多样性(Discriminative Score)、保真度(Fidelity)、实用性(Predictive Score)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: GAN方法判别分数普遍高于0.94,说明合成时序与真实时序分布差异大,GAN难以生成复杂MTS数据
evidence_for_taste: GAN-based methods generally obtain a discriminative score above 0.94
In some settings, DiffWave slightly outperforms Diff-MTS
Diff-MTS w/o Ada-MMD achieves an average predictive score of 21.840
some unique characteristics of the datasets or specific noise factors
DiffWave slightly outperforms Diff-MTS, such as FD001 with lengths of 96
thinking_moves: 从GAN训练不稳定问题倒推扩散模型的稳定性优势
将时序分解技术(均值池+最大池)引入扩散模型的U-net结构
用MMD替代分类器实现无分类器条件控制
通过消融实验逐个验证Ada-MMD和TDR-UNet各组件的贡献
